pro.P_Name as conProjectName, c.C_Name as conPartyBName, pro.p_id as pId, c1.C_Name as conPartyAName, c2.C_Name as conPartyAOtherName, c3.C_Name as conPartyCName, c4.C_Name as conEvaluateBName, c5.C_Name as conEvaluateAName, c.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, c1.C_Abbreviation as conPartyAAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as conPartyAOtherAbbName, con.Con_Name as conRelieveConName, con.Con_Code as conRelieveConCode, con1.Con_Name as conEvaluateName, con1.Con_Code as conEvaluateCode, con1.Con_Provisional_Pe as conEvaluatePeAmt, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sdep.D_Name as conDepName, mn.*, asett.as_Review_The_Amount as asReviewTheAmount, asett.as_Audited_Amount as asAuditedAmount, asett.as_Deduction_Amount as asDeductionAmount, asett.as_Reduction_Rate as asReductionRate, jl.Con_Name as conJlName, bp.bpPayable as bpPayable, bp.bpActualApplication as bpActualApplication, bp.bpApplicationDate as bpApplicationDate, bp.createUname as bpCreateUname, bp.state as bpState, from Con_Contract mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.con_Project_Id=pro.P_Id
left join SYS_Department sdep on sdep.D_Id=mn.Con_Department left join SYS_Company c on mn.con_Party_B_Id=c.C_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Con_Party_A_Id=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Con_Party_A_Other_Id=c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Con_Party_C_Id=c3.C_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Relieve_Con_Id=con.Con_Id left join Con_Contract con1 on mn.Con_Evaluate_Id=con1.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on con1.con_Party_B_Id=c4.C_Id left join SYS_Company c5 on con1.Con_Party_A_Id=c5.C_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Con_Section_Id left join Con_Contract jl on mn.Con_JL_Id = jl.Con_Id left join Balance_Payment bp on bp.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id ${params.authSql}
and mn.con_Party_A_Agent like concat('%',#{params.conPartyAAgent},'%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM completion_acceptance mn LEFT JOIN con_contract con ON mn.con_Id = con.con_id WHERE mn.con_id = #{conId} AND mn.ca_state = 7

select
pro.P_Name as conProjectName, c.C_Name as conPartyBName, c1.C_Name as conPartyAName, c2.C_Name as conPartyAOtherName, c3.C_Name as conPartyCName, c4.C_Name as conEvaluateBName, c5.C_Name as conEvaluateAName, c.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, c1.C_Abbreviation as conPartyAAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as conPartyAOtherAbbName, con.Con_Name as conRelieveConName, con.Con_Code as conRelieveConCode, con1.Con_Name as conEvaluateName, con1.Con_Code as conEvaluateCode, con1.Con_Provisional_Pe as conEvaluatePeAmt, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sdep.D_Name as conDepName, (select sum(isa.Sa_Approved_Amt) from Inv_Settlement_Apply isa where isa.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id and isa.Sa_State=7) as saApprovedAmtSum, (select count(*) from con_contract cone where cone.Con_Evaluate_Id=mn.con_Id and cone.Con_Approval_State=7) as conEvaluateCount, (select sum(cone.Con_Money_Total) from con_contract cone where cone.Con_Evaluate_Id=mn.con_Id and cone.Con_Approval_State=7) as conEvaluateAmt, (select count(cone.Con_Money_Total) from con_contract cone where cone.Con_Master_Con_Id=mn.con_Id and cone.Con_Approval_State=7) as conMasterAmt, (select count(*) from con_contract cone where cone.Con_Master_Con_Id=mn.con_Id and cone.Con_Approval_State=7) as conMasterCount, mn.*, jl.Con_Name as conJlName from Con_Contract mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.con_Project_Id=pro.P_Id
left join SYS_Department sdep on sdep.D_Id=mn.Con_Department left join SYS_Company c on mn.con_Party_B_Id=c.C_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Con_Party_A_Id=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Con_Party_A_Other_Id=c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Con_Party_C_Id=c3.C_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Relieve_Con_Id=con.Con_Id left join Con_Contract con1 on mn.Con_Evaluate_Id=con1.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on con1.con_Party_B_Id=c4.C_Id left join SYS_Company c5 on con1.Con_Party_A_Id=c5.C_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Con_Section_Id left join Con_Contract jl on mn.Con_JL_Id = jl.Con_Id
mn.Con_Approval_State!=3
and mn.con_Project_Id in (select child.P_Id from Pre_Project child where child.P_Parent_ID=#{params.conProjectId})

select pp.*, sc.C_Name as partyBName, psf.Fs_Cost_Code as fsCostCode, ca.Ca_Date as completeDate, ise.Sae_Audit_End_Time as endTime, ise.Sae_Audit_Report as auditReport, mn.* from con_contract mn left join pre_project pp on mn.con_Project_Id=pp.p_id left join sys_company sc on mn.con_Party_B_Id=sc.c_id left join completion_acceptance ca on mn.con_Id=ca.con_Id left join inv_settlement_end ise on mn.con_Id=ise.con_Id left join Pro_Sources_Funds psf on pp.P_Id=psf.P_Id
${authSql}
where 1=1
and pp.P_Name like concat('%', #{params.pName}, '%')
and mn.Con_Name like concat('%', #{params.conName}, '%')
and mn.Con_Code like concat('%', #{params.conCode}, '%')
and mn.Con_Category=#{params.conCategory}

select count(*) as conCount, COALESCE(sum(mn.Con_Money_Total), 0) as conMoneyTotal from Con_Contract mn where mn.Con_Approval_State = 7
and mn.con_Category = #{params.conCategory}
